## FactSet to Host Investor Day on November 10, 2026


September 14, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.factset.com/node/19291/pdf)


NORWALK, Conn., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS), a leading global intelligence and AI solutions provider to the financial markets, today announced that it will host an Investor Day on November 10, 2026, in New York City and via live webcast.


Sanoke Viswanathan, Chief Executive Officer, Josh Warren, Chief Financial Officer, and members of FactSet’s executive leadership team expect to discuss the Company’s strategy, product roadmap, and financial outlook, followed by a live question-and-answer session. The event will also showcase demonstrations of FactSet’s comprehensive solutions and broad set of AI-powered products.


**FactSet Investor Day 2026 Details**


**Date:** Tuesday, November 10, 2026


**Time:** 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time


**Registration:**[FactSet Investor Day 2026](https://id26.factset.com/)


Registration for Investor Day is required. Presentation materials will be available on FactSet’s[Investor Relations website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iFZZVGLIWo7JR4i7JHjfdLVEaOWRKDSAP1-fa0ovZfEfqyVr8YOutPT_vQkbA-Rt4VzYbYZX0AhX9lq5uDIG_jPolLn02iipj0b7hJVn6artM-hs0H3_LKDm01aPEsOAzfXz9NOhbRqDEyqX2fNzpBgndGq4Z4ti6ALQOvLAF_tS3csvr9cw9K-2VQNZ_N7HFwqihPa7Jo58tRyQYcmCWFjKQTeB94GstXiHRD_TS7KqDxstuGe_a89-aVO7Slfzf9LGMm31-B0d9Pf7FB68EiVbPiSxtsh5iIky850fBoCvhin7pyMm-QZn4eyd6HslgU4q-_DSW0mVx9eN-Lt4JG2YZq0LcchFZh_qa4n_-IBn-JqvL8qIF5ttkYIC8lCykx3MtijwSH3Gw315NUHgshUxqLHELd4HBfLWdrunYWTYmoayGFMukkoj2LH2PRQiydiaOen_MgHbeAJtJ3wyfNn6sormh4eguARbHCCA56J7QwXTxuVudPmJWN9SjTqhbCr3b2onnFIc0PZVRoc4-x6NqgSV2VpZ3KO4PIrfa8gaRruDU8-CZFOsfg_dCziJTmJ9ZeZqVzXvFgjvopVeaQShWKOd9EaKHP8mZxZkxcE=) at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on November 10, 2026, 30 minutes before the event begins. Following the event, a replay of the video webcast will be available for one year at[investor.factset.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WnyiF0kq7_xuNWNwdATlJLJai6g1lS04i2Eu6FhTlrfmo1GQw37eEgJwg6rKLE5ggRaZM5MWxDwWjLHCeoLIW7gMd2cEDwO0T5ngvLJVDTI=) .


**About FactSet**


FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) supercharges financial intelligence, offering enterprise data and information solutions that help our clients maximize their potential. Our digital platform seamlessly integrates proprietary data, third-party sources, and flexible technology to deliver tailored solutions across the buy side, sell side, wealth, and corporate sectors. With over 47 years of expertise, we leverage advanced data connectivity, AI, and next-generation tools to streamline workflows and enable smarter decision-making. As an S&P 500 company serving more than 9,100 global clients and over 247,000 individual users, we are dedicated to innovation and long-term client success.
